## Read in Downloaded GEO counts:

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(Orpheus)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object.Rds")

seurat_obj$seurat_clusters = seurat_obj$all_cell_types
```

clustering:

```{r}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "all_cell_types")
```

Add ZT information to Seurat object:

```{r}
table(seurat_obj$orig.ident)

matches <- stringr::str_match(seurat_obj$orig.ident , "ZT(\\d+)$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
seurat_obj$ZT = ZT
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = c("nCount_RNA"), group.by = "ZT")


table(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters, seurat_obj$orig.ident)
```

### What are reasonable params for my simulated data?

```{r}
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = "hepatocytes 2", normalize = F)
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
plot(log(means), log(vars))
theta_estimate = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
summary(theta_estimate$coarse_theta)
summary(means)

#Reasonable estimates for theta: 0.01 - 2.5
quantile(theta_estimate$coarse_theta, probs = c(0.05, .95))

#Reasonable range for gene means (G): 0.05 - 5
quantile(means, probs = c(0.05, .95))

cyclers = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat = pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
cyclers$p_statistic = as.numeric(cyclers$p_statistic)

#What fraction of genes should I make rhythmic? 0.3
sig_cyclers = dplyr::filter(cyclers,p_statistic < 0.05)
sig_cyclers %>% nrow / nrow(cyclers)

#Reasonable range for cycling amplitude_ratio?: 0.3 - 0.75
quantile(as.numeric(sig_cyclers$amp_ratio), probs = c(0.05, 0.95))

```

## Now do Methods of Moments analysis (ORPHEUS)

```{r}
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in unique(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters)){
  
for(seed in c(1:4))  {
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type, "seed", seed))


# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, normalize = T, num_replicates = 2, random_seed = seed)
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")
vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

if(length(unique(diff(ZT))[unique(diff(ZT)) != 0]) != 1 || length(unique(ZT)) < 6){
  print("Cell does not have time points suitable for analysis")
  next
}

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat)

all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb)

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)


phi = calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = 0.5)

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) = paste0(cell_type,"_seed" ,seed)
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}
}
```

### Combine lists from different celltypes/pseudoreplicates and plot

```{r}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

save(cos_phis_tmm, file = "~/Desktop/phis_2pr_4folds_unfilt.RData")
load("../../figures/mouse_liver/two_pseudoreps_4Folds/phis_2pr_4folds_unfilt.RData")

cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)

phis_filt <- cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")

phis_consensus = phis_filt %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)

#Now phis_consensus has repeat genes for each "seed"
#gene count by cell type:
phis_consensus %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarize(n_genes = n_distinct(Row.names))

pval_cols = c("p_statistic", "double_freq_p_statistic")
phis_seed_avg <- phis_consensus %>%
  select(!contains("acrophase") & !contains("AIC") & !contains("BIC")) %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(pval_cols), max, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of(pval_cols), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
    cell = first(cell),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% filter(cell %in% c("hepatocytes 1","hepatocytes 2", "pericentral hepatocytes", "periportal hepatocytes"))

jitter_width <- 0.15
jitter_seed <- 123 # A specific seed for reproducibility

custom_colors <- c("cholangiocytes" = "#883923", "endothelial cells 1" = "#E68613", "hepatocytes 1" = "#E69F00", "hepatocytes 2" = "#56B4E9", "kupffer cells" = "#00BFC4", "pericentral hepatocytes" = "#F8766D", "periportal hepatocytes" = "#F0E442")

liver_phi_boxplot_pseudorep = ggplot(phis_seed_avg, aes(x = cell,y =  phi*12/pi, fill = cell))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab("Cell type")+
  ylab("Prediceted phase std. (hrs)")+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5,
      position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
   ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # The x-axis labels are sufficient
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1), # Angle labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )

ggsave("~/Desktop/liver_phi_boxplot_pseudorep.pdf", liver_phi_boxplot_pseudorep, device = "pdf", width = 8, heigh = 6)

kruskal.test(phi ~ cell, data = phis_seed_avg)
pairwise.wilcox.test(phis_seed_avg$phi, phis_seed_avg$cell,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

acrodiff_compare_pseudorep = ggplot(phis_seed_avg, aes(x = acrodiff*12/pi, fill = cell)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "black", alpha = 1, breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 2)) +
  facet_wrap(~ as.factor(cell), scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  guides(fill = "none") +    # remove fill legend
  xlab("Fundamental vs 2nd harmonic of variance\n absolute acrophase diff. (hrs)")+
  ylab("Count")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase x-axis text size
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),    # Increase y-axis text size
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)    # Increase legend title size
  )+
   # Use scale_x_continuous for precise control over the x-axis
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 12), 
    breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 4), 
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )

ggsave("~/Desktop/acrodiff_compare_pseudorep.pdf", plot = acrodiff_compare_pseudorep, device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 4, units = "in")
```

```{r}
#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
```

### Theta analysis

```{r}
#Let's look at theta from when phi is calculable or from where double_freq_amplitude > V_2w_floor:

theta_df = cos_phis_tmm %>% mutate(V_2w_floor = -(Ac^2/2)*theta) %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed") %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)

#Now phis_consensus has repeat genes for each "seed"
#gene count by cell type:
theta_df %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarize(n_genes = n_distinct(Row.names))

pval_cols = c("p_statistic", "double_freq_p_statistic")
theta_df_consensus <- theta_df %>%
  select(!contains("acrophase") & !contains("AIC") & !contains("BIC")) %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(pval_cols), max, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of(pval_cols), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
    cell = first(cell),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% filter(!is.nan(phi) | (double_freq_amplitude < V_2w_floor)  )


clock_genes = c("ARNTL", "NPAS2","CLOCK","CRY1","CRY2","NR1D1","NR1D2",  "PER1","PER2","PER3","DBP","TEF","ARNTL2","RORA","FBXL3","CSNK1D","CSNK1E")

theta_df_consensus = theta_df_consensus %>% mutate(clock_gene = toupper(Row.names) %in% clock_genes)

theta_df_consensus
```

```{r}
# Create a directory to store the output files
dir.create("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_phi_rnk")

cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
  group_split(Source) %>%                           # Split into a list by Source
  walk(~{
    # For each dataframe in the list...
    
    # Get the unique source name for the filename
    source_name <- .x$Source[1]
    
    # Construct the output filename
    filename <- file.path("~/Desktop/mouse_liver_phi_rnk/", paste0(source_name, "_sorted_phi.rnk"))
    
    # Arrange by phi, select the two columns, and write to CSV
    .x %>%
      arrange(phi) %>%
      select(Row.names, phi) %>%
      write.table(file = filename, 
                  row.names = FALSE,
                  col.names = FALSE,
                  sep = "\t",
                  quote = F)
      
    # Print a message to the console
    message(paste("Wrote file:", filename))
  })


```

```{r}
    })
```
